statement: Offline tests with mock fetch implementations and mock responses (marked MOCK). No model was called, no credential or environment value was read, and no network attempt was made.

results.name: every PRE body rebuilds from the frozen prompt and texts to its frozen hash, with exactly the planned fields
all 401 frozen bodies rebuild to their hashes; a changed record text is refused
headers are exactly content-type, x-api-key (the injected value) and anthropic-version 2026-10-21; POST to the one URL with redirect "error"
a forbidden body field (temperature, top_p, top_k, fallbacks) or a non-user final turn is refused before any request
a 200 response is captured once, journalled with its hash and usage, and maps to the candidate text
exact quotations verify through the frozen 0.3.5 compile (scorer v2 units); a one-character change makes that quotation absent and withdraws its support

strict parsing: non-JSON text, an extra key, the wrong prompt version, a missing key, a fence with extra text: each rejected; one exact fence is accepted (documented in the frozen strict-json.mjs) and counted
adapter: two text blocks, a tool_use block, empty text, text over 64 KiB and a different model are each refused
a truncated response (stop_reason max_tokens) is final, captured, never retried, and the adapter refuses it
a refusal (stop_reason refusal) is final with its category, never retried and never sent to another model
a timeout aborts the attempt, is retried twice, and every attempt is counted at the worst case
cancellation in flight stops the request, counts it at the worst case, and a resend of the same request is refused
retry accounting: 429 (retry-after honoured), 529 and 500 are retried; error statuses are not billed; the final 200 is billed from usage
a retry-after beyond the 20-second window ends the request without waiting; the runner stops (SR-07)
HTTP 400, 401, 402, 403, 404, 409 and 413 are final after one attempt and stop the run (SR-03)
HTTP 504 is final, counted at the worst case (billing unknown), and stops the run (SR-05)
redirects are refused, never followed and never retried: a 3xx status, or the fetch error a redirect raises under redirect "error" (SR-04)
a network error is retried twice, counted at the worst case each time (B9), then stops the run (SR-06)
the destination allow-list refuses every other scheme, host, port, path, query, fragment or user part before any request; the gate refuses a destination override
budget enforcement: an attempt whose worst case would pass the cap is refused before it is sent; spend never passes the cap
request cap and global attempt cap (B6) each stop further sending; the runner reports SR-12 or SR-18
interrupted run: the "sent" entry is on disk before the request leaves (B10); on resume it becomes interrupted_unknown at the worst case and is never resent automatically (SR-16)
interrupted after the capture was written: recovery verifies the capture against the prepared body hash and records it with its reported cost
interrupted before sending ("prepared" only): the request is sent normally on resume
attempts made before a resume count toward the retry limit (B7): two earlier attempts leave one
a completed request is never sent twice: dispatch refuses it, and the runner skips it on resume without calling the sender
the journal hash chain detects an edited or removed entry
authorization: absent, the three unsigned drafts, a signed copy that keeps a draft identifier, the spent Stage A authorization, and missing or placeholder fields are refused

authorization: expired, dated in the future, wrong model, prompt, plan, record set or API version, reserved credential name, unauthorized phase, request outside the plan, later phase without PRE, caps exceeded: each refused
the build gate refuses before any check, credential lookup or request; the command exits 4 having read nothing
the credential is looked up only after the authorization verifies, only under its one named variable, and never reaches the journal or a capture
a credential value, or a credential-shaped string, in a response is refused at capture (SR-15)
PRE end to end with mock responses: frozen bodies, gate, journal, captures, offline compile; the PRE gate passes; the scorer classifies every request and marks it MOCK
PRE gate: two invalid contract outputs of three fail the gate and stop before RUN; one of three still passes
stop rules: refusal and truncation in PRE (SR-08, SR-09), input above the frozen estimate (SR-13), wrong model (SR-14), a compiler-side failure (SR-11)
the scorer refuses a capture whose hash differs from its journal entry, and one whose body differs from the frozen request
private location: the repository and any git working tree are refused; the session scratch is accepted
the token estimate (B4) is at or above the documented average for every frozen body; the frozen length/3 estimate is below it
the network guard blocks a real request in a child process; this process recorded no network attempt
fail closed: a failing check makes a tool exit 1
an authorization that does not verify stops the run before any request (SR-02); a missing credential variable stops it at the gate before the request is sent (SR-01)
resume across phases: after PRE completes, a resumed run skips PRE, passes the PRE gate from the journal and captures, and continues to RUN
